dmp.description: The aim of the interdisciplinary project, which combines the field of humanities and arts with research methods of natural sciences, is to promote public understanding of technology change processes in the dyeing of textiles in Latvia in the 19th century, providing new knowledge about traditional cultural heritage and industrial history. In the research, based on the study of written sources, practical dyeing,  and chemical analyses of historical textile samples, new knowledge will be gained about the history of clothing and the introduction of chemical achievements into public use in Latvia in the 19th century.

project.description: The goal of the project is both to activate the research of the history of clothing and other topics related to it at the University of Latvia, as well as to accumulate data and to promote the study of the chemistry of dyes at the University, which will allow the University to take a leading position in the research of these topics in Latvia. Clothing and the technologies used for its production, including dyeing, reflect the value system, way of thinking, openness to novelties, or, on the contrary, the conservatism of views existing in society in different periods and provide evidence of the directions of information flows. Therefore, the project aims to contribute to the general study of the history of clothing, which will allow a better understanding of the processes in society both in the past and today. A significant fact in the history of clothing and textiles was the introduction of synthetic aniline dyes, the 19th-century worldwide chemical novelty, into production and usage; however, this process has not been studied in detail in Latvia so far. The implementation of the project will allow the creation of new knowledge about the use of natural and synthetic dyes in the territory of Latvia and the modernization processes of textiles, including clothing, that took place in the 19th century, expanding the understanding of Latvia’s place in the European cultural space.
